authoring.author: claude (kinkerstraat-types lane)
authoring.note: Kinkerstraat 30-2 (even side, Bilderdijkkade end), 1886-1889. Proof face for the Oud-West Kinkerstraat type library: 9 pands of kinker-1890-brick-arched (18-4 row, 2 modules on 18-20 and 4-6), 3 of kinker-1890-plain-brick (30, 24, 22), 2 of kinker-1895-painted-band (28, 26), corner 2 and the corner block. Shops read on zoom crops of the 2024-12-11 strip; names only where legible, else OSM with agreement osm-only.
